entities.title: Contractor quote follow-up validation
entities.summary: Two independent public sources show a recurring slow-quote-response complaint pattern worth validating cheaply.
entities.problemHypothesis: A measurable quote acknowledgement and follow-up workflow problem may be reducing conversion.
assumptions: Public complaints may overrepresent negative experiences.
A workflow change could improve acknowledgement without guaranteeing revenue.
The complaint pattern reflects a current workflow.
A validated improvement would have repeatable value across contractors.

entities.cheapestValidation: Build a mock-data quote acknowledgement prototype through Mission Control and compare it with 25 public contractor funnels; no live outreach.
stopConditions: Stop if the public pattern is not present in at least 20 percent of the bounded sample.
Stop before outreach unless the owner separately approves it.
entities.recommendedNextAction: Prepare an owner proposal for a mock-data validation prototype and bounded public research.
